Case Number:
25STLC04460
Hearing Date:
March 10, 2026
Dept:
26
TENTATIVE RULING:
Defendant Stanislav Poliakov’s Motion for Order Setting
Aside Default is Granted. Defendant is to file and serve the proposed Answer to
the Complaint within 20 days of this ruling.
Analysis:
On June 6,
2025, Plaintiff Oscar Monge (“Plaintiff”) filed this action against Defendant Stanislav
Poliakov (erroneously sued as Stanislav Pollakov) (“Defendant”). Following
Defendant’s failure to file a responsive pleading, the Court entered Defendant’s
default on December 12, 2025. Defendant then filed an Answer on December 15,
2025. On January 5, 2026, the Court struck Defendant’s Answer for having been
filed after entry of default. (Minute Order, 01/05/26.)
Defendant filed
the instant Motion for Order Setting Aside Default on January 27, 2026. The
Motion was served on Plaintiff through Attorney Christopher J. Lauria, Esq. by
electronic mail on the same day. No opposition has been filed to date.
Discussion
Defendant
moves to vacate the entry of default pursuant to Code of Civil Procedure
section 473, subdivision (b).
Under this statute, an
application for relief must be made no more than six months after entry of the
order from which relief is sought and must be accompanied by an affidavit of
fault attesting to the party or attorney’s mistake, inadvertence, surprise or
neglect. (Code Civ. Proc., § 473, subd. (b);
English v. IKON Business
Solutions
(2001) 94 Cal.App.4th 130, 143.) When based on attorney fault
with respect to entry of default, default judgment, or involuntary dismissal, a
timely request for relief must be granted. (Code Civ. Proc., § 473, subd. (b).)
The
Motion was timely filed less than two months after the entry of default and is
supported by an affidavit of fault from Defendant’s attorney, declaring that they
inadvertently failed to timely file a response to the Complaint. (Motion, Kim
Decl., ¶¶4-6.) The Motion is also accompanied by a copy of Defendant’s proposed
Answer. (
Id
. at Exh. A.) Therefore, the case must be reinstated under
Code of Civil Procedure section 473, subdivision (b).
Conclusion
Defendant Stanislav Poliakov’s Motion for Order Setting
Aside Default is Granted. Defendant is to file and serve the proposed Answer to
the Complaint within 20 days of this ruling.
Moving party to give notice.
